name: Ben & Jerry's Chunky Monkey Ice Cream (Walnut WARNING)
whyItWorks: Packed with dense, whole roasted walnut halves and thick fudge chunks. Walnuts contain fibrous tannins and tough woody cell walls that pass undigested, posing severe obstruction hazards for narrowed bowels.
prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID. Choose smooth ice creams without nut mix-ins.
